proposal.reason: Main change is in the IB network backend: connection handshake/state machine moved into Connect/Accept, QP RTR/RTS setup updated (GID/FLID routing, ECE negotiation, traffic-class handling), and receive-size/completion signaling behavior changed. Also includes an independently substantive memory-registration ownership change via a per-device, reference-counted MR cache for register/deregister reuse and cleanup.
